title: Account Switch – Zoom Lesson – Cross-org students – Each student joins own Zoom lesson
description: AC PX-1507.01 — Scenario — Each student at Renseikai and Asojuku opens and joins the Zoom lesson assigned to that student.
preconditions:
- Student Renseikai is logged in to the mobile app.
- Student Asojuku is logged in to the mobile app.
- Student Renseikai has a joinable Zoom lesson Renseikai Zoom.
- Student Asojuku has a joinable Zoom lesson Asojuku Zoom.
steps_actions: 1. "Student Renseikai opens Renseikai Zoom and selects the join action."\n2. "Student Asojuku opens Asojuku Zoom and selects the join action."
steps_result: 1. "Student Renseikai is directed to the Zoom meeting for Renseikai Zoom."\n2. "Student Asojuku is directed to the Zoom meeting for Asojuku Zoom."
steps_data: 1. "organization = Renseikai; lesson = Renseikai Zoom"\n2. "organization = Asojuku; lesson = Asojuku Zoom"
